metadata.description: Personal omp plugins, maintained alongside my dotfiles

plugins.name: pr-wording-review
plugins.description: Interrupts PR title or description writes that read as machine-generated, so the agent reviews its own wording before the PR exists.

plugins.name: tool-gate
plugins.description: Argument-level permission policy: bash command patterns and protected paths, deterministic decisions, JSONL audit log.

plugins.name: worktree-kit
plugins.description: One worktree tool the agent cannot misuse: placement is owned by the plugin, and direct git worktree commands get flagged.
